title: Momoi Airi — An Ordinary Moment〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Everyone ready?
Especially you, Shizuku. I don't wanna hear about how your screen went blank or something.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Thank you, Airi, but I'm all set to watch now.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Hehe. This is so exciting! “Chat A Lot About Nothing with Takashi Arimura!”>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <A ton of people on social media also seem to be looking forward to it. They've even been adding #MOREMOREJUMP! to their posts!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <We need to thank you for spreading the word through our official account, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <All I did was come up with what to say and when to post it. We have Saito to thank for everything else.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Yes, you're right.
We really can't thank her enough.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hey, sooner or later, you're gonna have to learn how to post stuff on social media instead of making her do everything.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Oh, one more minute until it starts!
I hope they show us a lot! We tried really hard during the talk segments and gave the best reactions we could!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Me too. But I wouldn't get your hopes up too much.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Yes, that shoot went really well, but we were there as replacements for someone else.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <So, there's a good chance that they placed a focus on the guests who were scheduled to be there from the start.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <They gave our segment a lot of airtime.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <But they left in the part where I stuttered!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Of course they left it in. That was pure gold.>

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Alright, let's have our resident fashionista Yuika give her verdict!

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line:
Who's more fashionable...?
It is Airi, or is it Minori?

rows.Speaker: Yuika
rows.Line: Personally, I don't think “cute” is the right word for what I'm seeing... I'd have to go with “interesting”...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Th-Th-This was my attempt at a street look since I don't often wear these kinds of clothes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think this cap with a bandana tied around it is one of its biggest selling points—

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
W-Wait just right there!
No one said anything about us giving presentations on our outfits!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<Was I really that jittery?!
I thought I did okay during the shoot...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <Don't worry. You did your best, and it shows.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <I was afraid that your explanation would get cut short since you did sorta go on for a bit...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Oh, really? I thought they'd leave it in since the audience was smiling and laughing the entire time.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yeah, it was! And we all appeared on camera.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <You said that we shouldn't get our hopes up too much, Airi, but I think we're all glad that you were wrong.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Our segment was one thing, but they also showed us a lot during the other talk segments and stuff.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <My hope was that they'd include some of those portions since we got pretty good responses...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Do you all remember what Mr. Arimura said before our shoot started back up?>

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: You get into a habit of drawing lines when you're in a studio like this, but the crew and personalities all want the show they're working on to be good. We all want the audience to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Arimura
rows.Line: Which is why it's so important to take a step back, forget the lines in the sand and remind ourselves of what the audience is feeling.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I remember...
But what's that got to do with us?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes, we saw ourselves as “replacements” when we were first given this offer.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <But Minori did her best and tried to bring as much fun to the show. All of the crew and guests also did the same, no?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I feel like we were accepted as real guests, which allowed us to put on a successful shoot. As a result, we've been receiving all these new offers...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <You did. The results that you achieved clearly made you the MVP of that shoot.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Wait, I forgot! I was gonna post a message on social media once the show ended.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Let's go with... “Thank you to everyone who watched the show! Please use the hashtag and let us know what were your favorite parts!♪”>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Just gotta throw in my name at the end and... Send!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Oh, like what other idol groups do! Seeing your name at the end makes it look so official!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's the point. All of us gotta start doing this more so we can...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<No, I left my notifications on!
I need to turn the log off too...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Phew. That was scary.
I wasn't expecting to receive a response so quickly...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<That was incredible.
I thought it was your phone's alarm there for a second.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Whoa! More and more people are replying to your post, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <I guess means our appearance was a success.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<And we have you to thank, Minori!
We couldn't have done it without you!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hey, I get that you're happy, but don't come crying to me after your parents scold you for being so loud.>
